cues.en: Hellooooo! I'm super super excited to start and hopefully you are too.
cues.zh: 哈囉！我非常期待開始，希望你也是。

cues.en: But in order for us to uncover this world of data science and machine learning we need to understand what we are learning and where we're going to end up.
cues.zh: 要探索資料科學與機器學習的世界，先了解要學什麼，以及最後會走到哪裡。

cues.en: So we have a clear path to success.
cues.zh: 這樣才能有清楚的成功路徑。

cues.en: Now this course has over 300+ videos that are broken down into sections.
cues.zh: 這門課有 300 多支影片，分成不同章節。

cues.en: So let's go over the sections so you know what the plan is.
cues.zh: 先看看各章，了解整體規劃。

cues.en: First, we start off with a really fun section machine learning 101. what is machine learning? we're
cues.zh: 首先是很有趣的「機器學習入門」章節。什麼是機器學習？我們，

cues.en: going to play around with some fun tools and understand what this whole craze around machine learning is so that you're able to explain this to your friends family and dog.
cues.zh: 會操作一些有趣的工具，了解這股機器學習熱潮，讓你能向朋友、家人和狗狗解釋。

cues.en: Okay maybe not the dog.
cues.zh: 好吧，狗狗可能不行。

cues.en: Once we get comfortable with the idea of machine learning we understand a history and how we got here and how it works on a high level.
cues.zh: 熟悉機器學習的概念後，會了解它的歷史、如何發展至今，以及大致運作原理。

cues.en: We then have two paths for you to follow.
cues.zh: 接著提供兩條學習路線。

cues.en: One is if you don't know Python or have never programmed in your life. Well we're going to teach you some Python so that you're able to follow the rest of the course.
cues.zh: 如果不懂 Python，或從來沒有寫過程式，我們會先教你 Python，讓你能跟上後續課程。

cues.en: The other path is for those who are already familiar with programming and python and want to just dive straight in so you can pick Python or we keep going with the course.
cues.zh: 另一條適合已熟悉程式設計與 Python、想直接開始的人；可以選擇先學 Python，也能繼續往下。

cues.en: The next part is about work environment.
cues.zh: 下一部分是工作環境。

cues.en: We all want to have a professional setup that you're going to use in real life scenarios.
cues.zh: 我們希望有能用在實際情境的專業設定。

cues.en: So we're going to introduce you to topics like Jupyter notebooks, Conda and virtual environments so that by the end of the section you have a professional setup.
cues.zh: 會介紹 Jupyter Notebook、Conda 與虛擬環境，完成這章後就有專業的工作環境。

cues.en: And when you go into work on your first day on the job you understand exactly what you need to install on your computer.
cues.zh: 第一天上班時，也會清楚知道電腦需要安裝什麼。

cues.en: We then move on to data analysis how do we analyze this data that we have using libraries like pandas.
cues.zh: 再來是資料分析，如何使用 pandas 這類函式庫分析手上的資料。

cues.en: Then we learn about a very important library when it comes to data science and that is NumPy, a fundamental tool for all data scientists.
cues.zh: 接著學習資料科學很重要的 NumPy，它是所有資料科學家的基礎工具。

cues.en: Then we move on to data visualizations.
cues.zh: 然後是資料視覺化。

cues.en: This is gonna be really fun because we get to work with libraries like matplotlib that allows us to make really neat graphs and visuals to describe our data.
cues.zh: 這部分很有趣，會使用 Matplotlib 這類函式庫，繪製漂亮的圖表，描述資料。

cues.en: We then go into the very popular scikit-learn. If you want to get into machine learning,
cues.zh: 再來是很熱門的 scikit-learn；如果想進入機器學習，

cues.en: You need to know this library and scikit-learn allows us to use models and train models and check how accurate our machine learning models are.
cues.zh: 就必須了解這個函式庫；它讓我們使用及訓練模型，並檢查機器學習模型的準確程度。

cues.en: In that section we're going to learn a complete workflow for a machine learning project.
cues.zh: 那一章會學習機器學習專案的完整工作流程。

cues.en: Then things get interesting.
cues.zh: 接著就更有趣了。

cues.en: This is when we start working on real life project and actually dive deep into machine learning.
cues.zh: 開始做實際專案，真正深入機器學習。

cues.en: We're going to learn about supervised learning about neural networks, transfer learning, deep learning.
cues.zh: 會學習監督式學習、神經網路、遷移學習和深度學習。

cues.en: We're going to do projects on classification, regression.
cues.zh: 會做分類與迴歸專案。

cues.en: We're going to build models around time series data.
cues.zh: 也會為時間序列資料建立模型。

cues.en: Now we're not going to shy away from difficult topics here.
cues.zh: 這裡不會避開困難主題。

cues.en: We're going to introduce you, especially later on in the course, to advanced topics like deep learning,
cues.zh: 特別是後半部，會介紹深度學習，

cues.en: neural networks, and transfer learning and we use the latest version of TensorFlow and Keras to do fun projects like image classifications, transfer learning.
cues.zh: 神經網路與遷移學習等進階主題，使用課程當時最新的 TensorFlow 與 Keras，完成影像分類和遷移學習等有趣專案。

cues.en: We're even going to show you how to use GPUs on your models to accelerate the training.
cues.zh: 也會展示如何用 GPU 加速模型訓練。

cues.en: This is going to be a really fun part where we actually work on real life projects and we're going to have
cues.zh: 這一部分很有趣，會實作真實專案，最後會有，

cues.en: notebooks and workbooks by the end of it to show off on your portfolio. We then get into data engineering.
cues.zh: Notebook 與練習成果，可以放到作品集展示；接著進入資料工程。

cues.en: Data engineering is actually a whole field in itself but as a data scientist you need to understand what they do and what the big high level concepts are.
cues.zh: 資料工程本身就是完整領域，但身為資料科學家，需要了解他們的工作，以及重要的高階概念。

cues.en: On topics like Hadoop and Spark so that you know how they're used in the industry and you can communicate with data engineers.
cues.zh: 像 Hadoop、Spark 等主題，了解產業如何使用，才能與資料工程師溝通。

cues.en: This is a part that's often missing in a lot of courses.
cues.zh: 很多課程常漏掉這部分。

cues.en: But one of my favorite parts is this last part: the storytelling and communication. something that we're
cues.zh: 但我最喜歡的其中一部分，是最後的故事敘述與溝通。我們，

cues.en: very excited about because it's a topic so important but often forgotten that is in order for you to be a successful machine learning and data science engineer,
cues.zh: 非常期待，因為這個主題很重要卻常被忽略；要成為成功的機器學習與資料科學工程師，

cues.en: You need to be able to communicate your work, present your work to management, to boss, to your co-workers.
cues.zh: 必須能夠說明工作成果，向管理階層、主管與同事展示。

cues.en: So using our experience working in the industry we're going to show you how to work on your storytelling and communication to present your project and to really stand out from all your colleagues.
cues.zh: 我們會運用業界經驗，教你改善敘事與溝通，展示專案，讓自己在同事之中脫穎而出。

cues.en: Data Science is a popular field and in order for you to succeed we want to go beyond just the basics and communication is a big part of that.
cues.zh: 資料科學很熱門；要幫助你成功，不能只停在基礎，溝通就是重要的一環。

cues.en: As you can see we have a lot to cover here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，內容非常多。

cues.en: A lot of videos and a lot of exercises.
cues.zh: 有很多影片和練習。

cues.en: But I promise you it's going to be a lot of fun.
cues.zh: 但我保證會很有趣。

cues.en: As a matter of fact, we're going to follow a storyline where you get hired at a company and all these tasks are going to be thrown at you by a boss.
cues.zh: 實際上，課程會沿著一條故事線：你被公司錄取，主管不斷交付各種任務。

cues.en: And we've mimicked these tasks based on our experience working for companies so that when you land your first job... well, you wont have any surprises or at least you're used to the work environment.
cues.zh: 任務根據我們在公司的工作經驗設計，讓你找到第一份工作時，不會太意外，至少熟悉工作環境。

cues.en: By the end of it all this is all going to fit in together and make sense from the very beginning of machine learning and data science basics to the very end with building our own projects.
cues.zh: 最後，一切會串起來，從最初的機器學習與資料科學基礎，到最後自己建立專案，都能理解。

cues.en: We're going to take you from zero to mastery but you know what the best part of this course is? Our online community.
cues.zh: 我們要帶你從零到精通；但知道這門課最棒的是什麼嗎？是線上社群。

cues.en: We have thousands of developers chatting every day helping each other out solving problems together just talking about the latest and greatest in programming data and the tech world.
cues.zh: 每天都有數千位開發者聊天、互相幫忙、一起解決問題，討論程式設計、資料和科技的最新資訊。

cues.en: Now this is an optional resource for you to use so you can have back and forth conversation with other students and myself and Daniel.
cues.zh: 這是可自由選用的資源，能與其他學生、我和 Daniel 雙向交流。

cues.en: The ideas for you to feel like you're part of a classroom and you're not doing this all by yourself but you know what?
cues.zh: 希望你感覺自己是班級的一員，不是獨自學習；但你知道嗎？

cues.en: Enough talk.
cues.zh: 說得夠多了。

cues.en: I know you're getting excited.
cues.zh: 我知道你很期待。

cues.en: I am too.
cues.zh: 我也是。

cues.en: So let's get started in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片就開始。

cues.en: It's your first day at work and we're going to start this course.
cues.zh: 那是你第一天上班，我們也正式開始課程。

cues.en: Let's start learning and see why, Being a data scientist has become one of the most in demand skills in the world.
cues.zh: 一起學習，看看為什麼資料科學已成為全球最熱門的技能之一。

cues.en: Let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。
